matched_rules.because: Two cooling systems failed simultaneously while outside temperatures were extraordinarily high, matching the rule's conditions.

next_actions.action: Immediately assess whether the data center can maintain a safe operating temperature; if not, plan to power down servers to prevent an even longer outage or damage to machines.

escalate.reason: Simultaneous failure of redundant cooling systems and rising temperatures (R-005 trigger).

not_covered: No rule addresses the specific scenario of two cooling systems failing while outside temperatures are extraordinarily high without additional signals such as voltage swells, control system failover, or chiller restart issues.

per_finding.note: R-005 matches the simultaneous redundant cooling failure with extreme outside temperatures, the exact root cause.
The triage does not mention terminating preemptible VMs or any specific load-reduction action.
R-005's next action explicitly directs powering down servers if safe temperature cannot be maintained.
The triage does not call for investigating advanced thermal load reduction methods.
The triage does not mention auditing cooling equipment or standards.
The triage does not provide or track the duration of the cooling failure impact.
